description: Search open jobs for foreigners on Seoulstart: jobs in South Korea that hire people on foreign visas, remote jobs, global jobs (including Japan) and AI training work. Returns the number of matches and a link to the list on Seoulstart. Global jobs (outside Korea and Japan), AI training jobs and free sample jobs come back in full: title, company, location, posting date, a link to the job page and, for Korea and Japan jobs, Seoulstart's read of the language level needed and the likely visa route. Every other match is locked and carries only the role type, the city and the posting language; titles, companies, pay and apply links are for Seoulstart members. Fits questions about jobs in Korea, jobs in Japan, English-speaking jobs in Seoul or Tokyo, visa sponsorship in Korea or Japan, D-10 or E-7 jobs, and AI training work.

english_posting.description: true: only postings written in English.

korean.description: Korea jobs only. none: no Korean needed. some: no Korean or conversational Korean.

limit.description: How many jobs to return (default 5, at most 10).

market.description: korea (default): jobs located in South Korea. remote: remote roles. global: jobs outside Korea, including Japan. ai_training: AI training and data annotation work.

query.description: Words to match in the job title, company or location, for example "data analyst", "Samsung", "Busan", "Japan" or "Tokyo". Leave empty to list the newest jobs.

visa_route.description: Korea jobs only. e7: employer likely sponsors the E-7 work visa. d10: fits the D-10 job-seeker visa. e9: Employment Permit System. f_series: for people who already hold an F visa.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Seoulstart Jobs
